approved_spec: Fix per-parameter reaction slider, expose module master source/band beside React All, and add timed A/B ping-pong with Hold/Fade while preserving performance and owner update security.
project_compatibility: Project format 1.3.0 remains unchanged; ux41_pingpong is an optional extra field readable by UX41. Older readers can ignore the unknown setting.
perf_scope: One module routing transaction per click; no polling timer for ping-pong and no rack relayout per reaction drag. Input latency preserved.
